Definition: an Ardite (collectively) or descendant of Ard
BiblicalUsage: The word means an Ardite, a descendant of Ard, and it appears once, in the census of Benjamin in the plains of Moab, where the family of the Ardites is counted beside the family of Naaman.
TheologicalSignificance: A family named after one man can outlast the man by generations, and the census keeps the count.
